title: Josephine
overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a crime in Golden Gate Park, she begins to act out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice, and a way to feel safe again.

title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
overview: Gibney’s “Knife” will explore Rushdie’s recovery “in the broadest sense”, according to a press release. Through Rushdie’s wife Rachel Eliza Griffiths’ personal footage, which has never been seen by the public, the doctor will follow the writer during not only his physical recovery but also the recovery of his spirit and hope for the future. In "Knife", Rushdie writes, “It’s a story in which hatred—the knife as a metaphor of hate—is answered and finally overcome by love.”

title: The Fox
overview: In this dark comedic folktale, an affable foxhunter encounters a shape-shifting fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his partner into the perfect woman and in doing so take control of the natural world.

title: Noah
overview: The death of a young Arab man during a police stop in Berlin sparks three interconnected and tragic episodes: two young Afro-Germans struggle to channel their rage; the victim’s mother, torn by grief, feels compelled to defend her son’s honour; and a group of police officers, trapped in routine and clouded by prejudice, make a series of misguided decisions amid the city’s charged atmosphere.

title: Offroad
overview: Set under the southern sun of the Canary Islands, three friends find themselves in over their heads in pursuit of freedom, dreams and a man named Francisco.  Maggie’s (Sofie Jo Kaufmanas) life looks perfect; she has a career, a home and a boyfriend, but inside she is slowly being suffocated by expectations and the weight of her own ambitions.  With her friends Eva (Julie Rudbæk) and Stine (Katinka Lærke Petersen), she sets out on a girls’ trip to Tenerife in search of freedom and dreams. But soon, one impulsive decision sends her and her two best friends on a reckless and chaotic journey across the island in a campervan.

title: Особый пациент
overview: Brilliant plastic surgeon Berladin takes on the most challenging case of his career—restoring the face of the disfigured sergeant major, Perkhun. While helping his patient find hope for the future, the doctor unexpectedly encounters his own family secret. These circumstances upend his life, forcing him to radically reassess his past and concepts of goodness and justice. The fates of the surgeon and his patient become inextricably intertwined, and the trials they face force each to choose between duty, love, and the right to start anew.

title: The Ascent
overview: Wedding guests at a European resort face terror when their celebration turns into a life-or-death struggle high above dangerous waters teeming with sharks.

title: Corpus Delicti
overview: In the near future, the “method” controls the health and freedom of society. The life of neuroscientist Mia Holl, who is loyal to the system, changes abruptly when her brother Moritz Holl is wrongly accused of murder and imprisoned. In the fight for truth and justice, Mia begins to question the system and becomes the hunted herself.

title: Artificial
overview: An undercover cop is assigned to monitor a humanoid robot, but an unexpected bond over art leads to a final task: creating a painting.

title: Nightmares
overview: The true story that became the basis one of the greatest horror movies of all time, following a journalist attempting to uncover the truth behind several unexplained deaths

title: Heart of Light: Eleven Songs for Fiji
overview: After decades abroad, Iona returns to her childhood home on Fiji, sensing that there she might find the answers to many questions she has about civilisation and its discontent.

title: Era Uma Vez Minha Primeira Vez
The Little Mammoth
overview: Fluffy the baby mammoth awakens after a thousand-year slumber in the icy desert and sets out to find his mother. They say she can be found in distant and mysterious Africa. But Africa is far away, and getting there is extremely difficult, and the baby mammoth's only companion is a chick named Tupik, who dreams of performing his rap at the "Africa's Got Talent" competition. Together, they must overcome numerous challenges: crossing the ocean on an ice floe, escaping from bloodthirsty crocodiles, defeating treacherous hyenas, performing their music in front of a wide variety of audiences, and, most importantly, learning to be friends and understanding that friendship means responsibility and support.

title: Robbin' the Hood
overview: Two brothers are roped into a scheme to rob from the rich and give to the poor, only to find their victims are not who they think they are.

title: Two Hornets
overview: An independent Slovak queer horror drama following themes of self-discovery and dark tension. Directed and written by filmmaker Dominik György, the film blends atmospheric psychological drama with horror elements against local forest settings.

title: Pianke
overview: The story of a young German boy and his father who befriend a Jewish family during WWII.

title: GUR: Code "Sikora"
overview: Maksym is a pilot of an Mi-8 military helicopter, call sign "Sikora". Raised by his military grandfather, Maksym has been used to acting on moral grounds rather than under stress since childhood. When a full-scale war breaks out, he does not immediately rush into battle. But after the atrocities committed by the Russian military in Bucha, Irpin, and Donetsk region, he can no longer remain silent. The viewer is presented with a story not only of war, but also of the inner transformation of a man who is faced with the choice every day to stay on the sidelines or to become one of those who resist.

title: Watching People Watching Birds
overview: Highly topical, serious and humorous, this film observes people who are passionately devoted to bird watching. Through their eyes and ears, we discover the world of the birds that becomes a metaphor for the state of the world.

title: Land of Wonders
overview: Young artist Philip unexpectedly finds himself in a true Land of Wonders—a secret, magical world hidden in the vast expanses of Siberia. A thrilling adventure awaits him, meeting the fantastical Imor people and their amazing animals. But due to human intervention, the Land of Wonders and its inhabitants are in danger of destruction. Philip must save this magical world and his new friends at any cost.

title: The Iris Protocol
overview: For years, Iris believed the surface was unsafe. But when she leaves the safety of her bunker, she unearths a reality far more twisted than she imagined—crafted by the man who raised her.

title: The Flood: End of Mankind
overview: Three days before the great flood, Noah races against time to warn others of God's impending judgment on all mankind.

title: Fiction's Hands
overview: In a tall, abandoned, and oppressive house, Luz pursues Mira, her childhood friend who takes refuge in the darkness, terrified of being seen. Amidst labyrinths of books and interwoven memories, their reunion clashes with reality. Argentine psychological and surreal horror about destructive love and the cost of vulnerability in fiction.

title: Mom's Blues
overview: A small provincial town. A young doctor's morning begins with an anxious knock at the window. A panicked woman reports that her child is dying. The doctor rushes to help and discovers signs of abuse on the child's body. An investigation begins, and the doctor is drawn into the dark depths of a family tragedy.

title: Marble Tears Taste Like Wine
overview: A volatile chess prodigy struggling with anger management attempts to navigate a world that feels hostile, dismissive, and chaotic. While chess offers him control and identity, real life repeatedly provokes his buried rage. After fleeting moments of connection and hope, a final altercation spirals into irreversible violence, forcing him to confront the devastating cost of losing control.

title: Red Egg of the Crimson King
overview: In a dilapidated apartment drowned in the oppressive hum of electricity, a man kills his evenings by watching, through a hole in the wall, an empty stage bathed in childish music. This strange routine brings him a fragile joy.  But one evening, something appears: an egg-shaped object marked with a face. An enigmatic presence. An angel… God?

title: De Club van Sinterklaas film: Paniek in het Pietendorp
Believers
overview: A ragtag amateur cricket team from the UK tours The Gambia to face a national side far beyond their level. As losses mount and bonds deepen, they discover what the game truly means to them.

title: Digger
overview: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

title: Verity
overview: Lowen Ashleigh gets hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who's unable to finish after an accident. Lowen uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

title: Shabara
overview: An adventure written in the stars and across time.

title: Bonkey: The Mutated
overview: An alien disease spreads like wildfire infecting a chain of unsuspecting victims. A man and his dog are all that stand in the way of containing the danger.

title: Crawlers
overview: When a man returns from a trip unwittingly harboring a new breed of arachnid, the people in an apartment block are quarantined and left to fend for themselves against a plague of venomous spiders.

title: Not Only Dogs Lick
overview: In a quiet house, Leonor spends her days in near-constant solitude, while her mother, Diana, works tirelessly around the clock to support them. One night, after a terrifying experience in her room, Diana tries to comfort her by giving her a puppy, hoping its companionship will help her sleep peacefully. At first, the dog becomes her refuge and inseparable companion. But when the shadows begin to move again and the strange noises return, Leonor will discover that not everything that licks her hand in the dark is her pet.

title: The Fall of Barsisa
overview: A modern re-imagining of the fable of the same name. Three brothers leave their ailing sister in the company of a devout and honourable figure as they are guided by an ambiguous stranger through treacherous terrain in search of a remedy.

title: Chameli Ko Poi
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: Nomad Shadow
overview: A young Sahrawi woman faces deportation to Western Sahara, struggling to readjust to her homeland and confront family tensions sparked by her earlier departure.

title: Untitled Cat Commercial
overview: A commercial for cat treats that cause lasers to shoot from the feline’s eyes to stop home invaders.

title: Forever, This Ring
overview: Maveric Collins, a successful entrepreneur and playboy, has promised to never get married — until he meets the woman of his dreams and changes his mind. But when they get married, he finds out she’s actually not who he thought she was. “Will the woman he once loved go away calmly, or will this end in a deadly divorce?”

title: Part-time Death Angel
overview: After his father's arrest shatters his once-stable life, college student Shinji falls into deep despair. One day, he is approached by his classmate Yuki, who invites him to join a strange part-time job—working as a "Death Angel." The job involves resolving the lingering regrets of the departed who cannot move on, and guiding them peacefully into the afterlife. Although skeptical at first, Shinji gradually regains hope as he helps each of the departed fulfill their final wish and pass on. Just as their part-time work seems to be going well, a secret Yuki has kept hidden is revealed, bringing an unexpected turn to their lives.

title: Ownerships
overview: Vera and Lucas, a frustrated couple in their forties, find a huge apartment at half the usual price thanks to a “bare ownership” deal: they buy it now, but the elderly owner will keep living there until he dies. What seemed like a miraculous opportunity soon turns into an obsession when Jesús disappears, reappears changed, and stops behaving like someone on his last legs. Caught between suspicion, frustration, and increasingly dark humor, the couple begins to consider a plan as absurd as it is tempting.

title: ママがもうこの世界にいなくても　私の命の日記
overview: A terminally ill woman chooses to have a child and spends her final days embracing motherhood with courage and love.

title: Brotherhood: A Cinematic Musical
overview: A movie musical about two neighboring families — one American, and one Mexican — and what it means to truly love your neighbor.

title: Under the Red Light
overview: A documentary film about photographer Romualdas Požerskis.

title: Nine Days of Sadness
overview: An isolated gamer accidentally discovers an analog-style game that promises deep human connection with an anonymous player on the other end of the screen --- only to discovers the horrors the game is built on.

title: Kontra K: Orchestrated - Live from Channel Aid 2026
Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
overview: Meet the inspiring individuals and communities who work to protect our most beloved UK wildlife.

title: Deadsight
overview: A cold-blooded contract killer known only as Deadsight executes without hesitation in order to clear his criminal record.

title: Secrets of the Southwest
overview: Discover the hidden stories Britain's southwest has to offer. From Foxes fighting on the streets of Bristol to Puffins looking for love on Skomer Island.

title: Maharashtra Epstein Files
overview: Plot TBA; inspired by the real-life scandal surrounding the self-styled godman Ashok Kharat alias 'Captain'.

title: Take His Life
overview: Beneath the glitter of London's finance world, a destitute man forces his way back from the streets into power. Over the course of a week, his hunger for success hardens into obsession, exposing a ruthless truth: in a system built on glass, survival demands taking another's life.

title: The Metropolitan Opera 2026/27: Così fan tutte
D3STRO
overview: A young couple shares a deep passion about food and desire for each other. They put all their efforts to satisfy all their fantasies, until they come with the ultimate culinary experience. One must be eaten and the second must feed from the other’s flesh.

title: The weight of water
overview: A guy, who just woke up, has to face the tough reality of water weight.

title: When Anyone Sees
overview: Christian, a young man overlooked by society, burdened by a dark past and escalating madness, finds himself trapped in a world of violence and despair.

title: Travel Reminiscence
overview: At a London community centre, facilitators and volunteers run a travel-themed session for people living with dementia and their families, friends and carers.  Together, the group embarks on a playful journey: discussing past trips, revisiting these through theatre, and writing postcards to loved ones.

title: Adore Him
overview: Through cinematic reenactments that span salvation history and intimate modern-day interviews from around the world, this film explores the transforming power of meeting the Creator of the Universe face to face. From encountering the Ark of the Covenant as it traveled across the wilderness to bumping into Jesus as he taught in the marketplace, this story builds to a culmination in the Eucharist, and today millions are finding out how much God truly loves them as they adore Him in the Blessed Sacrament. He is here. Will you come?

title: NYRA II
overview: Trapped in a series of looping dream timelines, Nyra is hunted by an unknown killer and must find a way to escape before the cycles consume her.

title: Sex, Power & Drugs: Act I
overview: First installment in the franchise.

title: Three Ghosts
overview: The show is scheduled to be performed at PARCO Theatre in October 2026!  (Performances also scheduled in Osaka, Fukuoka, Aichi, Okayama, and Miyazaki in November-December)

title: Motherland
overview: Patria I is a medium-length film by Juan Ibarlucía and Magela Crosignani that reimagines the form of the Baroque oratorio within the post-industrial landscape of Argentina in 2026. Drawing on a south american reinterpretation of the myth of Cain, and employing music, poetry, performance, and installation art, the work takes the audience on a powerful sonic and emotional journey that spans an extraordinary range of human experience—from extreme violence to compassion and tenderness.

title: Butterfly Jam
overview: 16 years old Pyteh splits his time between the wrestling mat and his family’s struggling Circassian diner in Newark. A single impulsive decision by his hustling father changes the course of his life, shaping a tale of pride, legacy, and masculinity.

title: Ducobu et le fantôme de Saint-Potache
Too Many Beasts
overview: In the French countryside, wild boars ravaging crops spark an open war between farmers and members of a gentlemen’s hunting club, who feed the game between hunts. Brun, a bankrupt farmer, struggles to keep his farm afloat. When the club’s president pushes him to his limits, Brun shoots him and disappears. A year later, Fulda, a volatile police officer just transferred to the region, leads the investigation. Still struggling after a recent breakup, and as wild boars proliferate across the region, he is pushed to the brink of sanity.

title: PAN DE AJO
overview: Victor, a shy and anxious guy, goes to Gabriel's apartment for the money he owes him. When he opens the door to Gabriel's room he will find nothing but horror...

title: The Florist
overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

title: Matchbox
overview: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

title: Pha Chan
overview: Plot TBA.

title: First Witch
overview: A couple journey to a small town to visit a traditional healer for alternative conception methods, when they soon discover the dark secrets of the town's past.

title: Nightmare Hospital
overview: A horror film about a pilot who is the sole survivor of the plane crash in the deep unknown. He must survive in an isolated building where something evil is waiting.

title: Raw Plan
overview: When Christina returns as a teacher to the school where she was once a student herself, she carries with her a past she thought was long over. In the classroom she is confronted with the problematic Mathilde, 16, who has lived in a shelter since her mother's death. Their meeting sets off a power struggle that quickly grows beyond the classroom walls. Mathilde struggles to hold on to a world that is falling apart around her, while Christina struggles not to become who she once was. Harassment, secrets and lies pull them towards a darkness neither of them can control.

title: Little Happy Pills
overview: A young woman tries to keep a steady balance between her expectations, desires and personal life, however, her emotions and everyday routine keep getting in her way.

title: Race to Monte Carlo
overview: This is the story of the visionaries behind Russia's first mass-produced automobile. In 1908, automotive enthusiast Andrey Nagel and engineer Dmitry Bondarev gather a team of like-minded individuals and begin developing a car. When the viability of their endeavor looks uncertain, Andrey Nagel makes the risky decision to enter their car in the Monaco Rally - a move that could make or break the budding automobile manufacturer's future.

title: Led by the Ashes
overview: Two sisters, Bethânia and Laura, reunite to discuss a family matter. They travel the roads of the Pernambuco hinterland in search of their father's body, Seu Lauro. At home, Bethânia's daughter edits a video in which the living and the dead become intertwined in a game of silences and revelations. Ao Sabor das Cinzas (Led by the Ashes) is a magical realism piece about the collapse of communication and grief conveyed in real time.

title: Lügen über meine Mutter
overview: In the 1980s, the life of a family in a small village is determined by just one issue: the mother's body weight. Her husband Werner decides that she needs to lose weight, Cornelia suffers as a result and their daughter Ela is caught in the middle.

title: The Spiral
overview: Centers on a mother-daughter relationship that spirals out of control following a shocking revelation. During a thunderstorm, Anna shows up unannounced at the student apartment of her daughter Alice and reveals that their entire family history rests on a lie she told her. Anna claims to have made a pact with a mysterious stranger to save Alice’s leg after an accident 20 years earlier. That pact has triggered a domino effect causing terrible events over the years. Only Alice can help to put everything right. But at what price?

title: Interlude
overview: Following a failed suicide attempt, Clara is in a coma and discovers that the afterlife is a giant Scrabble tournament. It all makes no sense, and yet, she must win the competition to overcome her demons.

title: Cartório das Almas
overview: Laura, a “young woman” of 126 years old, is the newly hired at Notary of Souls. In her new role, she records the motivations of those who renounced eternity. However, by contract, Laura herself cannot interrupt her tedious existence.

title: The EGGsplosive Easter 2.0. Quantum Paradox
overview: After the events of the first part, where Ivan Zabiyaka built a ballistic missile, he takes on a new invention: a Time Machine, disguised as an old minibus.

title: Alte Liebe
overview: The everyday life of a married couple at a turning point: Lore wants a divorce—after almost 40 years of marriage.

title: M.E.N.A.G.E.R.I.E
overview: A test subject is picked to find the location of a missing prisoner. After old memories resurface, the subject finds himself up against something not of this world....  (Based on the Menagerie universe by Robert "Wertpol" Brock)

title: Eine Krankheit wie ein Gedicht
overview: Jelena Ilić's father suffers from drug-induced psychosis and has been in forensic psychiatry for five years. Now the day of his release is approaching. How can the director be sure that her father will not relapse and become violent again? How can a reconciliation be achieved? And how can society successfully reintegrate a mentally ill offender?

title: Ducks
overview: A young Frenchman of Cambodian origins goes to his country in search of himself.

title: When people ask where you're from
overview: Sonja Aigner, born in South Africa and now living in Germany, reflects on identity and belonging after a DNA test reveals connections across the world.Through a quiet and intimate conversation, the film explores what it means to come from a place and whether that answer is ever complete.

title: Fjord
overview: After the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave everything behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth offers the promise of a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghius' young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

title: The Social Reckoning
overview: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

title: Other Mommy
overview: A young girl, her family and their home are haunted by a sinister entity that is determined to take up residence inside her. But first, it needs to persuade her to let it in…

title: Angel and the Badman
overview: In this remake of the classic western, a feared outlaw staggers onto a rancher’s land expecting a quick death, not mercy. But the rancher’s daughter offers him a chance at a life beyond violence. Now, with an outlaw gang threatening his new home, he must decide what kind of man he’ll be when the world demands blood.

title: Tenzing
overview: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

title: Monster Mia
overview: Expelled student Mia and her pet rat Quentin arrive at Rotwood Academy, where she's the only human among monster classmates. With Principal Van Vlad's hatred of humans, she must team up with monsters to thwart his schemes.

title: Ashes
overview: Lucila leaves Mexico with her younger brother to reunite with their mother in Madrid, who had left a few years earlier to chase a better future. When they finally arrive, the bitter, suffocating reality that awaits them proves far harsher than Lucila had imagined. Still, she is determined to make the most of this fragile new life.

title: Adult Supervision
overview: Three fathers join their daughters on a school trip to a quiet island. Stranded with a chaotic group of teenagers, they’re forced to confront past traumas as the line between play and power games slowly dissolves.

title: To You in the Beyond
overview: Kazuki Tsukigase is a high school boy who carries a certain secret. In search of a place where no one knows him, he enrolls at Sakijima High School on a remote island.  On Sakijima, there is a place known as the "Cove of Spiriting Away." One early summer day, Kazuki finds a girl lying unconscious in the cove. The girl—Nanao, 16 years old—later regains consciousness in the hospital, but her identity remains unknown. What is the meaning behind the word "1974" that she murmured?

title: You, Like a Star
overview: Kai Aono is a high school student. He transfers to a scenic island in the Seto Inland Sea from Kyoto. There, he meets high school student Akimi Inoue, who was born on the island and lives with her mother. They fall in love with each other, but they are forced to make a choice due to their own fates.

title: Almost There
overview: An aspiring musician nearing thirty grapples with the end of her carefree twenties as life demands she embrace maturity and responsibility.

title: Girls und Panzer das Finale: Part 5
overview: The fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou film series.

title: Run Terry Run
overview: The extraordinary story of Canadian icon Terry Fox will be told like never before in Run Terry Run, a new feature-length documentary directed by acclaimed filmmaker Sean Menard. The film offers an intimate, behind-the-scenes look at Terry’s legendary 1980 Marathon of Hope, drawing from 96 reels of never-before-seen footage and unheard audio interviews that have remained untouched for 45 years.

title: The Girl We Let In
overview: Following the adoption of their longtime babysitter, 16 year old Sophie, Hope begins to suspect her new daughter is hiding a terrible secret that will endanger her family.

title: Waves Turn
overview: Women reflect on their first year of motherhood and the many joys and challenges it brings – for parent and baby. A gentle, curious and informative conversational documentary about postpartum life, of sublime analogue beauty.

title: Eh Din Roz Ni Aune
overview: Introducing Avkaash Mann

title: The Blind Ants
overview: In 1935, a storm caused an English ship carrying coal to run aground in Bizkaia. Residents of Algorta gathered to rescue the coal, but Sabas Jauregui ignored their pleas and dragged his children into the storm.

title: The Journal: Starting From Research
overview: A team of three book writers, try to research the life of one of their friends named Fika for the next 30 days. To get accurate results, they have to stay overnight at Fika's house. Initially the research went smoothly until finally strange things happened and of course Fika's behavior changed. Whether all this happened by chance or there was something behind this event.

title: It's FRIDAY
overview: On a sweltering May night, five seventeen-year-old friends gather for a pre-party drinking session, intending it to be their ultimate escape. However, the party spirals out of control when Laura suffers severe alcohol poisoning. Fearing the consequences and desperately seeking refuge, the group locks themselves in an empty house against the clock. In the suffocating confinement of this claustrophobic isolation, each girl's selfishness and secrets are laid bare, transforming the medical emergency into a brutal psychological examination that will test the limits of their loyalty and forever alter their relationships.

title: Outsiders
overview: Davey's Chambers life is forever altered when an alien invasion forces him to survive with strangers inside of his compact flat.

title: Analog Eyes
overview: A loner dork gets fed up with the monotony of his existence under the shadow of his narcissistic friend. Forcing the the pair to reevaluate their place in life.

title: INFECTIOUS
overview: Years after a global collapse caused by a strange pandemic, a former healthcare worker testifies in court about an illegal transplant operation that may have triggered the outbreak. What began as an illegal heart transplant ended up releasing a virus capable of turning those infected into violent, cannibalistic creatures.

title: HOW TO UNMASK A FCKN INCEL?
overview: Matías, an introverted young man and rock music enthusiast, agrees to go out with his roommate, Hugo, unaware that they'll end up at a gay nightclub. There, he tries to connect with Gloria and fit into an environment that feels foreign to him, but his insecurities, prejudices, and social awkwardness lead to a series of uncomfortable situations. When Celine confronts him about his attitude toward women, Matías is forced to confront an image of himself he had never questioned.

title: Throw Away the Lover
overview: The only son of an Azerbaijani vampire family brings the girls he falls in love with home to meet his parents.

title: My Body is a Prison
overview: Conner brings his pillow to life

title: Mike
overview: A young man spirals through buried trauma and impulsive choices, igniting a thrilling descent into loss, desperation, and survival.

title: Un castello
overview: Martin is a boy who lives a tormented love for Karin, a girl who instead seems to want nothing more than to escape from him, until she gets sick and remains under the boy's care.

title: Currents
overview: 4 strangers follow completely different paths through the same day. Leading them all to meeting at a beach party filled with chaos, drama, and action.

title: Dolioo
overview: Sarah Jamson, daughter of Hudson’s murdered ally, wages a one-woman war against Hudson, using stealth, strategy, and vengeance-marked corpses to haunt him psychologically. Chloe Varenne, a symbol of lost love and innocence, becomes the spark that pushes KAEL toward rebellion.

title: Eva
overview: On a romantic journey through isolated landscapes, a couple discovers that the most unsettling danger may arise from what they choose to hide or reveal.

title: Arachnado 2: Flaming Spiders
overview: Just when you thought it couldn't get any worse, the Arachnado has returned, this time as a "Firenado" with Flaming Spiders. It's up to a renegade Sergeant Preston and the Janitor from the original film to overthrow the corrupt Lieutenant Gallagher and put the fire out.

title: Bunker Heights
overview: Citizens of a troubled city must navigate through an unforeseen crisis that threatens every walk of life.

title: Friday's Chylde 3D
overview: Friday's Chylde 3D

title: Iron Boy
overview: In rural France, Christophe (10) tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?

title: Les Misérables
overview: After enduring 19 years in prison for stealing a loaf of bread, Jean Valjean emerges a hardened man. He seeks redemption by reinventing himself as a respected dignitary under a new identity. He promises Fantine, a dying factory worker, to rescue and protect her daughter Cosette, who is being exploited and mistreated by the deceitful Thénardier family. As Valjean raises Cosette as his own, he is relentlessly pursued by Inspector Javert. Admist the social unrest shaking France, the fates of Valjean, Cosette, her lover Marius, and Javert become intertwined in a turbulent, revolutionary Paris. Through struggles, sacrifices, and a deep yearning for justice, Valjean strives to complete his journey of redemption and offer Cosette a future of love and freedom.

title: Maleepnedos
overview: An epic journey of uncanny proportion in which two friends must adapt and survive the peculiarities of this strange new world.

title: Afreet - A Never Ending Night
overview: Three friends gather for what should have been an ordinary evening, but a seemingly harmless challenge unleashes something far older and more dangerous than they could have imagined. As strange events begin to blur the line between reality and the unknown, they find themselves trapped in a night where every choice carries a consequence.  Afreet is a supernatural horror film that explores friendship, fear, and the hidden forces that emerge when curiosity goes too far.

title: Jailer 2
overview: Following the events of "Jailer",  former ruthless police officer Muthuvel Pandian must come face-to-face with an even larger threat.

title: November 1963
overview: Unfolds within the intense 48-hour period surrounding the assassination of President John F. Kennedy. The film sheds light on crime group the Chicago Outfit’s alleged involvement in the assassination and draws directly from first-hand accounts, including insights from the family of crime boss Sam Giancana.

title: Televil
overview: Glah discovers an old TV in the storage room of his house. On the screen, 90s TV shows are being broadcast featuring four teens who went missing 35 years ago, crying out for help.

title: Sacrifice
overview: During a star-studded charity gala brimming with celebrities, billionaires and empty speeches, a movie star in the midst of an existential crisis is taken hostage by a radical warrior and her devoted followers. As the night descends into chaos, both an inward journey and an outward adventure ensue, where the line between performance and belief, salvation and sacrifice, begins to blur.

title: Call Me Queen
overview: The film depicts a friendship between an Irish journalist in Kenya and a Rwandan woman, who pair up to combat the AIDS crisis in the 1990s.

title: Приключения пингвиненка
overview: The penguin Kwi is transferred from the Moscow Zoo to another city. However, during the transportation, an accident occurs, and the baby ends up alone in a big city. Thus begins his incredible journey home.

title: Visitation
overview: A plot of land, a house by the lake, its changing inhabitants. This one plot of land reflects 70 years of German history from Weimar, the Nazis, the war, the Soviet occupation and reconstruction to the fall of the GDR.

title: Руки вверх! 2
overview: Thirty years after the story of the band Ruki Vverkh! began, Sergey Zhukov together with his children revisits memories of his youth: his first love, his first big dreams, friendship, family, and the journey to the stage.

title: Dirty Angel
overview: A young woman gets involved in a typhoon of temptation, pressure, buried secrets and dangerous individuals that prowl the streets of night and has to use her internal strength to create a new balance in her shattered life and start living to the fullest once again.

title: Junkies of Dreaming
overview: Orchestra rehearsals with Teodor Currentzis. The House of the Radio of the GDR in Berlin. A young couple in love. The artistic process viewed from the outside – and from the inside. Mahler’s boundary-breaking Third Symphony. What triggered the composition 130 years ago, and what does it trigger in us today?

title: The Book of Dreams
overview: After his wife’s death, Bolot raises his daughter Kyial, who once defeated cancer. But the illness returns, and there is almost no time left. When he learns about her secret diary of wishes, Bolot decides to take Kyial out of the hospital and fulfill every one of her dreams. Joining them on this journey is Kyial’s best friend, Joki — a grown man on the autism spectrum, who in his own way helps them endure the pain and rediscover the value of every single day.

title: Дьол сэттэ күнэ
overview: The film tells the story of 27-year-old Prokopiy, a man with autism who lives in isolation under his mother's strict supervision. His closed world changes with the arrival of Aiyyna, a girl who opens the outside world to him. Their fragile relationship becomes a test for all the characters. Prokopiy decides to leave his familiar cage and live his "seven days of happiness," discovering the world and himself.

title: Sense and Sensibility
overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

title: Flywheel: Ignition of the Soul
overview: In Rio de Janeiro, Noah Silva is a smooth-talking, used-car salesman whose 'do whatever it takes' approach to business and life begins to unravel at home and at work. After a series of wake-up calls, Noah is forced to confront the cost of his choices. He begins a difficult and deeply personal journey to restore his integrity while trying to win back the hearts of his wife and son.

title: Street Fighter
overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

title: Hotel Tehran
overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend
overview: Faced with the truth about Miori and Touko Kirishima, Sakuta must make a choice. This will be his final case of Adolescence Syndrome!

title: Whalefall
overview: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
overview: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
overview: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

title: mentor
overview: Fifteen years ago, an innocent fireworks accident caused by two boys, Ryunosuke and Takumi, destroyed an apartment building. One resident, Nomoto, lost his wife and child in the fire and suffered severe burns across his body. Fifteen years later, Ryunosuke tries to live a "normal" life while suppressing his guilt, whereas Takumi remains emotionally trapped in the past. When Nomoto suddenly reappears before them, the expected confrontation never comes. Instead, he shows an unsettling kindness—one that deeply disturbs Ryunosuke, yet offers a fragile sense of salvation to Takumi. As their paths cross once again in a reunion that should never have happened, the lives of these three individuals begin to shift in ways that will irrevocably alter their futures.

title: Poetic License
overview: Liz, a former therapist and soon-to-be empty nester, becomes the unexpected point of tension between two inseparable best friends and college seniors, Sam and Ari. Liz is forced to re-examine her life as the boys' friendship unravels in a fierce competition for her affection.

title: The Eken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra
overview: Eken Babu’s next adventure, releasing on 16 October 2026.

title: La maleta
overview: Laura and Nacho meet on a flight, but their brief encounter ends when they pick up their bags. Laura proposes a game, revealing the suitcase belongs to terrorists.

title: Batulo Jun
overview: Plot to be announced.

overview: Based on a true story, B-Town is a tale of emotions, aspirations, and the harsh realities of Punjabi student life in Brampton, Ontario.

title: Aa Bata Aama 2
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: #Untitled Sangeeth Shobhan - Palnati Surya Pratap Project
The Time That Never Came
overview: In a world obsessed with youth, Sara chose to age naturally while Oskar, her partner, took an anti-aging treatment. Years later, when they reunite — divided by time but bound by the past — Sara begins a journey to reclaim lost love, confront buried emotions and find freedom.

title: The Pension Heist
overview: The film PENSJONSKUPPET (The Pension Heist) tells the story of three women in their prime who are written off as "too old" by their employers, their spouses, and even the healthcare system. But this feisty trio refuses to take it lying down. Together, they hatch a cunning plan to pull off the ultimate score… robbing Norway’s very own Sovereign Wealth Fund – the famous Oil Fund.

title: Your Silent Face
overview: A man in a seemingly stable relationship hides a private world of fantasy that slowly takes over his life. When a third presence appears, he is forced to confront what his addiction has done to intimacy, love and his own sense of self.

title: Red Dirt
overview: When Emma Bennett, a teen girl living in the South, finds out life changing news, she has to find a way to navigate it with the help of her best friend Oliver, all while keeping it a secret from her step brother, Jake.

title: The Observer
overview: A UFO mystery/thriller inspired by The Twilight Zone. Plot TBA.

title: Carlo Acutis: The Millennial Saint
overview: A high-profile documentary about 15-year-old Carlo Acutis, who, in 2025, become the Roman Catholic Church’s first millennial saint.

title: Superfly
overview: Coming Soon

title: Vape Glow
overview: Told entirely from the perspective of a recalled vape pen, Mike puffs around a dark vacation rental, illuminating it during an unusual blackout.

title: Raah Tere Ne
overview: Burma, 1944. After abandoning his post in the British Indian Army and stealing a fortune in hidden gold, a Sikh soldier journeys toward Punjab alongside an Anglo-Burmese woman chasing a homeland she has never seen. As greed, war, betrayal, and grief leave a trail of broken lives behind them, he must decide whether the road ahead leads to vengeance, redemption, or a deeper understanding of the divine path that has been guiding him all along.

title: flow
overview: A young person records a quiet walk through the woods. What begins as a casual video slowly reveals something harder to say.

title: Words of Love
overview: For 14 years, Erika has been the anchor of a household that rarely stands still, doing her best to raise teenage Abigail, her whirlwind little brother, Yoni, and a dog with an extreme devotion to cheese. When Abi’s desire to meet her absent father grows into a full-blown obsession and word spreads he’s been seen nearby, Erika fears the fragile balance will collapse for good. Instead, the unpredictable journey that follows brings mother and daughter to see each other anew, steering their lively, lovable family toward a happy new chapter.

title: Georgia
overview: Famous Vegas director Steven Leroy receives a video link of the Kartvelian sword fighting dance from his daughter Mirrey. It impresses him so much that decides to travel to Sakartvelo in order to create an unforgettable show.

title: Women as Lovers
overview: Although hostess Brigitte and life-loving schoolgirl Paula only meet in person once, their fates and lives are closely intertwined.

title: Karma
overview: In a village in northern Spain, Jeanne tries to rebuild her life with Daniel, who knows nothing about her troubled past. One day, Jeanne's six-year-old godson mysteriously disappears and Jeanne becomes the main suspect.

title: Let Love In
overview: After an affair comes to light, a couple's world unravels. Through confronting painful truths, they discover their crisis becomes a path to deeper connection and a new understanding of love.

title: Marie Madeleine
overview: In Jacmel, Haiti, the sea, the churches, and the spirits shape daily life. Marie Madeleine is a free woman. She makes a living as a prostitute and navigates the nights without submitting to the rules of those who save souls. Her path crosses Joseph's, a young evangelist. A relationship blossoms between these two opposite beings. As Joseph’s faith wavers, Marie Madeleine draws him into a world where desire and the quest for freedom open up a space where everything can be reinvented.

title: Le Roi du Game
overview: In conflict with his daughter Isaure, Alexandre discovers that she has been selected for the oral exam of a prestigious business school—her greatest dream. However, Isaure is nowhere to be found, lost in a weekend of medieval fantasy role-playing. To find her, Alexandre enters the game, taking on the role of a devious Game Master. But as the adventure unfolds, he realizes that he himself has been lost for years. Under the guise of "Renard Chafouin," he gets a chance to reconnect with his values—and to avoid losing his daughter forever.

title: Une femme aujourd’hui
overview: The life of a young woman is turned upside down after a violent assault, making her realize the fragility of her freedom.

title: The Lord of Cold
overview: Sisters Maria and Anastasia are best friends, and they cope not only with a grumpy mother, but also with ancient magic, because of which winter has not come in their village for many decades. The girls manage to overcome all obstacles, drive away the evil witch, melt the heart of the Lord of Cold, and also find love.

title: The Perfect Holiday
overview: The group of friends from “Das perfekte Geheimnis” have to ask themselves the question on a chaotic short trip to the south: Is there life after the truth or is their friendship over?

title: Nakee 3: The Cursed War
overview: As destiny turns lovers into enemies, duty tears them apart, but love remembers what kingdoms forget, the love can end even the oldest war.

title: Yellow Cake
overview: When radical science backfires, miners and researchers confront apocalypse in Tiago Melo’s pulpy, politically charged sci-fi fusing local myth, dark humour, working-class grit and radioactivity in Brazil’s Northeast.

title: SYNTHETICA
overview: Ada, a retired hacker living quietly as an art curator, discovers an illegal neural implant in their head after experiencing dangerous memory glitches. When an underground surgeon can't safely remove it, Ada is forced to accept one last job: infiltrate the corporation that created the device. As the mission unfolds, Ada must confront the truth about their forgotten past and the real purpose of the technology buried in their mind.

title: Flamin­go Flamenco
overview: The Fuente de Piedra lagoon in Spain is home to one of the largest flocks of flamingos in Europe. Once a year, the adolescent birds perform a dance that looks like... flamenco! But when the flock is attacked by hateful podencos (wild dogs) our heroine Rosie, a fun, dance crazy flamingo, loses her beloved sister and the flamenco is cancelled henceforth. She grows up a shadow of her former self, robbed of her sisters love and the joy of dance. One day she meets Carlos, an exuberant lizard, who encourages her to dance once more - rekindling her inner flame. Over time, she transforms back into her old confident self, before leading her flock to face down the podencos and dance once more.

title: Wonder Beast
overview: With fairy-tale inhabitants, everything is the same as with people - when a marriage breaks up, Resentment remains... That is the name of the daughter of the powerful magicians Bolotnitsa and Chernogor, who divorced but continue to share power over the child. On the day of Resentment's coming of age, it turns out that she is deprived of the magical power that was supposed to be inherited from her parents. To fix the situation, Resentment urgently needs to find a groom in the human world, have a wedding and sacrifice the person - turn him into a tree... Together with Resentment, her mysterious friend, Chudo Yudo, goes to the human world. He can transform into anyone: a bird, an animal, and even a handsome prince.

title: Die andere Seite
overview: Since losing her family, a woman is living alone in the wilderness — far away from society, which is dominated by mistrust and fear after the outbreak of a fatal disease. When she is forced to leave this life behind, she not only experiences a boundless freedom, but also remembers the importance of human closeness and the feeling of belonging.

title: Caught Between Lands
overview: An experimental documentary featuring international college students commenting on their experiences of cultural isolation in America.

title: Little Hearts: Madness of Love
overview: A broke, desperate filmmaker fakes a public proposal to chase online fame. It goes viral, turning into real love, real fallout, and a harsh choice feed the algorithm or protect his heart in a world where emotions are content, at any cost

title: A Dog's Show
overview: A disillusioned sheep dog triallist must come out of retirement and team up with his granddaughter to confront and defeat his nemesis - a mischievous sheep called Dolores - and overcome his neighbour, in order to save his family farm.

title: Materia Prima
overview: The Bolivian Andes are rich in both lithium and drama in a film about a new gold rush, where global interests collide and 500 years of colonial history continue to haunt the present.

title: Kingdom of Crooked Mirrors
overview: Olya lives with her grandmother, who loves to tell her magical stories. Her parents are always busy and are rarely at home. The girl quarrels with her family and accidentally ends up in the mirror kingdom from her grandmother's stories, where she meets her reflection - Yalo. In this world, all people are too absorbed in mirrors, because in them they see ideal versions of themselves. These magic mirrors were invented by Korshun to subjugate the entire kingdom to his power, and Olya will have to believe in a miracle and save the fairy-tale world.

title: Fatherland
overview: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

title: Clayface
overview: Follow the terrifying descent into hell of a promising Hollywood actor who has become a monster driven by revenge, exploring the loss of identity and humanity, the ravages of toxic love and the dark side of scientific ambition.

title: Wildwood
overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a forbidden magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to save Prue’s kidnapped baby brother, Mac, from the crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

title: Klara and the Sun
overview: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

title: Wicker
overview: An outcast in a fishing village commissions a husband for herself made out of wicker from the local basketmaker, but her unexpected romance with the intricate creation sparks jealousy and threatens the village's social order.

title: Animol
overview: Behind the walls of a young offender institution, Troy is thrust into a brutal world of gangs, loyalty and violence from the moment he arrives. When an unspoken bond develops with a fellow inmate, it becomes a dangerous vulnerability for them.

title: Wife & Dog
overview: A "return to the colourful, back-stabbing world of the British aristocracy", this pic follows the relentless greed of the Fairbank family and their associates who fuel betrayal and murder in the battle for succession.

title: In the Clear Moonlit Dusk
overview: The school’s cool, prince-like heroine has never questioned her role—until a fellow “Prince” enters her life and sees her as more than a hero, awakening feelings she’s never faced before.

title: La Venganza del Charro Negro
overview: The return of Leo San Juan and all the legends.

title: Lapland War
overview: Young soldier Heikki fights on the Karelian Isthmus alongside his friend Pauli. Arvo, recently released from prison, joins the company, challenging the others' views on war and duty with his worldview. The ceasefire raises hopes of returning home, but it soon becomes clear that Finland must turn against its former German allies in Lapland. At the same time, Saara, who works as a German interpreter in Rovaniemi, must choose her future: stay in Finland or flee to Germany with her beloved, Major Duisberg.

title: The Diary of a Chambermaid
overview: Gianina, a young Romanian, works as a housekeeper for a bourgeois family in Bordeaux. In the evenings, she rehearses the role of a maid with an amateur theater troupe in an adaptation of The Diary of a Chambermaid by Octave Mirbeau. She takes care of Louen, her employers’ son, while her own daughter is growing up far from her, in Romania. The maternal absence deepens into a wound but, as Christmas approaches, the promise of a reunion begins to take shape.

title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
overview: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

title: Faust
overview: After making a deal with the devil, an isolated and unsatisfied professor uses supernatural means to achieve success and happiness at the cost of his soul.

title: Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi
overview: Sequel to Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun.

title: The Bad Son
overview: Rubén, an eleven-year-old boy, lives in a rural area with his father until he suddenly disappears. In the aftermath, Rubén moves in with his grandmother, a woman he barely knows and with whom he must learn to coexist. In a setting where time seems to have stood still, their relationship gradually reveals a family history shaped by wounds passed down from one generation to the next. As Rubén grows older, he tries to understand this emotional legacy and find a way to break the cycle, confronting his past in an attempt to heal what he has inherited.

title: Swamp
overview: Years after her mother's disappearance, Jamie and her friends return to the lake where the woman claimed to see a terrifying creature. Soon after arriving, the keys to their car go missing, leaving the group trapped.

title: Paul and Greg and Amelia
overview: A novelist struggling with writer's block interviews his wealthy estranged college roommate and his wife, where an old secret threatens all of their safety.

title: Neural Command
overview: In a cold future, where society is controlled by technology. Ethan, has a flash of his life before and starts to question what it means to truly live.

title: The Bog
overview: A boy's body is discovered in a peat field, and a local drunk confesses to a decades-old murder. Policeman Broze reopens the case and is forced to confront his own role in the tragic game played by boys 30 years ago—a day he can't remember or forget.

title: Musical Hetalia ~World⭐︎Starts~
overview: Tenth musical adaptation for Hetalia

title: Convince Me
overview: When a heartbroken man is forced to convince the Devil to grant his wish, he must face the truth about himself or risk paying an eternal price.

title: Moulin
overview: In June 1943, Jean Moulin, leader of the French Resistance, is arrested while attempting to reunite the forces of the "Armée Secrète." Interrogated by Klaus Barbie, the head of the Gestapo in Lyon, Moulin is drawn into a relentless confrontation.

title: Lucy Lost
overview: Set in 1915 in the Isles of Scilly just off the Cornish coast, a young girl named Lucy is raised by a clan of fishermen she knows not to be hers. However, she remembers little else about her past, and as the Great War rages down on the continent, a chance encounter with the mysterious girl her own age soon helps Lucy put back the pieces of her own life’s story and come to better understand her place in the world.

title: Species
overview: Margot, a young intern at the country's most competitive ER, struggles in the high-pressure environment. When multiple patients her age arrive with strange symptoms, her own body begins experiencing alarming transformations.

title: All About Corinne
overview: Corinne Maclou is a background actor who dreams of one day being more than an extra. Confident her breakthrough is right around the corner, she befriends famous actor Sandrine Kiberlain, hoping it will help her achieve her goal — but there’s still a long way to go for her to be welcomed into the closed-off French cinema family.

title: Le Fantôme de l'Opéra
overview: Anastasia, an 18-year-old ballet dancer at the Opéra Garnier, becomes the obsession of a disfigured man living in the opera's underground labyrinth.

title: Paper Cuts
overview: A deeper look into Switzerland's counterfeits during WWII.

title: Free at Heart
overview: Sebastian's (16) sheltered small-town life changes suddenly when his family takes in 15-year-old Kolja, supposedly the son of his father's recently deceased girlfriend. In addition to his little sister, another teenager now lives with them.  Although the two boys are strangers to each other at first, they begin to open up to each other more and more and discover that they are biological brothers. The relationship of trust with his parents breaks down and when Sebastian and Kolja become closer than they expected, Sebastian's life is suddenly turned upside down, as he has found not only a soul mate in his new brother, but also a real, first love. Overwhelmed by their feelings, the two hide their relationship, but when the secret, incestuous relationship is discovered, the family breaks out of the social structure of the small town and comes into conflict with societal norms. Everything that follows is a rollercoaster of emotions.

title: The Blood Countess
overview: The Blood Countess and her maid embark on a quest for the red elixir of life and a book that threatens the vampire realm. Hot on their heels are a police inspector, two vampirologists, a vegetarian nephew and his therapist.

title: 100 Days
overview: "100 Days" is a feature film about Brazilian explorer Amyr Klink, who crossed the South Atlantic Ocean in 1984. It blends adventure, family drama, and emotional flashbacks from his childhood and teen years.

title: Rise of the Empire
overview: Upon returning home from his Grand Embassy, Peter the Great enters into a prolonged war with Sweden to secure access to the Baltic Sea. His path to victory is paved with setbacks, treachery, and deceit. Only by overcoming these challenges will he become Emperor, find true love, and establish Russia as a great empire.

title: Bloody Tennis
overview: Sophie is accepted into an elite tennis academy in Spain. But the price for success as the best tennis player in the world is high and may even claim her life.

title: Das Geheimnis der gestohlenen Maske
overview: Does the mask of the Makonde really have magic powers and can it settle the terrible quarrel between Johanna and her best friend? Johanna desperately needs the mask, but before her eyes it is stolen from Leipzig's Grassi Museum and Grandpa Kito is considered the prime suspect! Kito has just appeared from Tanzania and wants the mask, brutally stolen in colonial times, to return to his village. For Johanna, there is more at stake than unmasking the real thief - she must find her own identity.

title: Biermann
overview: Portrait of the German-German singer-songwriter and intellectual Wolf Biermann, whose famous Cologne concert in 1976 made German history.

Dead Howling
overview: A werewolf hunts zombies after losing his family. He meets two humans seeking sanctuary and joins their quest, protecting them with his powers. Their journey grows perilous as zombies start evolving.

title: RYUJI ⻯⼆
overview: The eternal legend etched into Japanese film history, rises again. (remake of the 1983 eponymous film).

title: Christmas at the Kringles
overview: The Seversons, a family of three living in smalltown suburbia, whose next-door neighbors, the Kringles, have one minor quirk: They celebrate Christmas all year round. Mark and Julie Severson have mixed feelings about how much time their son, Bobby, spends at the Kringles’. But it’s not until he goes missing within the confines of the Kringles’ home that they realize their neighbors—and their religion—aren’t what they seemed. The couple will embark on a life-and-death journey to find their son that not only tests who they are, but who they want to become.

title: Sweet New Suit
overview: This film takes place within the lives of two friends that conflict with one another, as "Q" can't take responsibility for his actions and loosely getting "Jazz" involved.

title: The Anta Claus of the South Pole
overview: Envious of his northern counterpart, the Anta Claus of the South Pole embarks on a penguin-powered journey to uncover the secret of a flawless Christmas. Along the way, he learns that the true spirit of the holiday lies not in perfection but in the lovable community of oddballs he left behind.

title: Stiletto
overview: A year after the grisly murder of a local exotic dancer, the victim’s sister, Lyric, searches for the serial killer responsible as he stalks and kills his favorite dancers on the night of the anniversary.

title: Absolution
overview: A character driven short drama about grief and survivors guilt set in Las Vegas.

title: Better Than A Shovel
overview: Carolyn and Howard are loving parents to their son Benny, but when they discover Benny may be developing unusual and dangerous behaviors, they devise a high risk mission in hopes of finding him a cure.

title: Every Breath We Take
overview: A murder investigation in a small rural town, marked by silences and loyalties, uncovers old secrets. Adoniran, a respected investigator, sees his life collapse when he goes from agent to prime suspect. While trying to prove his innocence, Saulo, Special Agent of Internal Affairs, returns to his hometown and must confront memories he would rather forget. Inner conflicts, fragile alliances, and unresolved recollections make the search for truth increasingly dangerous.

title: Sleepwalker
overview: After isolating himself from the outside world, a troubled sleepwalker discovers the pathway to an alternate reality, where he is guided by a mysterious entity. As he ventures further, he descends into the darkest corners of his subconscious.

title: The Pinecrest Lost Tapes: Chaos! Blood! & Violence
overview: Since the early 90s, Pinecrest, Massachusetts has suffered unexplained horrors. Nolan vanished without a trace in a winter storm. 23 years later, seven friends in a park discover the Rabbit has returned to Pinecrest.

title: Watergate
overview: A sequel to Rupert v Nixon and the end for the RNCU

title: Therapy with a Zombie
overview: A zombie seeks therapy after realising he's addicted to eating brains.

title: Nightblade
overview: The Nightblade Killer is on the loose during the night of a full moon.

title: A Corpse in Kensington
overview: A mysterious killing spree ignites suspicion among three former classmates who have rekindled a love triangle in their hometown on Halloween night.

title: Demonology
overview: A small team of paranormal investigators are hired to investigate a remote property where a grieving couple claims to have encountered a demonic force. As they unravel the mystery, they begin to realize they are not welcome.

title: Wolfmask 2: The return of Dario Durant
overview: As the survivors try to rebuild their lives, Víctor, the brother of one of the victims, forms a group to stop what many believe is just a legend. But revenge never rests, and the past always finds a way to return.

title: Scream: Short Film
overview: After a brutal murder reawakens Woodsboro's dark past, Cora Clemenzo is pulled into a new Ghostface killing spree as her friends in the Woodsboro High Cinema Club become suspects and survival means uncovering the truth before history repeats itself...

title: Carnal
overview: A lonely misogynist experiences strange occurrences after purchasing a peculiar product online.

title: + Add Friend
overview: A working man must confront his secret shame as his online activity unravels into his personal life- following an intimate encounter with an anonymous internet user.

title: Soft Things Rot
overview: A supernatural folk horror story about a witch who is helplessly in love with her roommate.

title: REEL
overview: After a late-night slasher screening, a group of horror-loving friends find themselves trapped in a terrifying game where slasher movie rules become reality. As eerie events unfold, they realize someone is rewriting the genre—forcing them to fight for survival in a film that’s still being written. The only way out? Break the rules before it’s too late.

title: Lights! Camera!! Scream!!!
overview: A group of friends travel to Maine to make a low-budget horror film, only to discover the behind-the-scenes chaos is far more terrifying.

title: Forget-me-not
overview: Dean Carter's mind unravels while deciphering the mystery behind the disappearance of his fiancé.

title: Slash
overview: A group of friends are terrorized by a masked killer on Halloween.

title: Bullet and Lace
overview: Bullet and Lace, a neon-soaked, Giallo-inspired nightmare, follows a young woman whose favorite true crime podcast becomes the voice of the masked intruder stalking her through the night.

title: Black Hollow
overview: Set in the rural Midwest during the 1970s, Black Hollow follows Jessica, an innocent young girl sheltered by small-town faith and her worldly friend Helen, whose rebellious streak leads them both into danger. When the two sneak out one foggy night, they wander to a forgotten churchyard, an isolated place where sacred ground conceals something unholy. As darkness descends, Jessica's search for belonging turns to horror, forcing her to confront the evil that thrives beneath the surface of the American heartland.

title: Knock, Knock, Knock
overview: Three years after the Jamestown NightStalker murders in 2024 that killed both his brothers, Collin Woods lives in a state of confusion and paranoia. Seeing a psychiatrist and living with his best friend, his symptoms worsen when a reoccurring dream predicts the return of The NightStalker. As people around Collin begin to be killed, he is forced to confront his fate, or watch as The NightStalker takes the couple things he still has left.
